نكتوي (form VIII)
# نَكْتَوِي (naktawī) /nak.ta.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَوَى (iktawā)
# نَكْتَوِيَ (naktawiya) /nak.ta.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَوَى (iktawā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
